programme.title: 海獵人 #1
programme.desc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧——「氣泡網捕食」來捕捉大量鯡魚。當牠們發現魚羣時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚羣困在其中。

programme.title: 海獵人 #2
programme.desc: 海洋生物學家伊芙・朱爾丹與理查德・考利奧森,已在挪威研究虎鯨兩年之久,觀察牠們如何將「旋轉圍捕」技巧適應於當地環境。

programme.title: 海獵人 #3
programme.desc: 在深海之中,敏捷迅速的海獅展現驚人的水下動作,以智取敵人。在巴塔哥尼亞的海灘上,一隻幼海獅正學習游泳,而掠食者已悄然準備發動致命攻擊。

programme.title: 海獵人 #4
programme.desc: 好望角塘鵝是強悍的獵手,翱翔海岸尋找最愛的獵物——沙丁魚羣,並等待一位意想不到的盟友: 海豚的協助。

programme.title: 海獵人 #5
programme.desc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹羣聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸。雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽。然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為。

programme.title: 海獵人 #6
programme.desc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊——海鷗。牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線。

programme.title: 海獵人 #1
programme.desc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧——「氣泡網捕食」來捕捉大量鯡魚。當牠們發現魚羣時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚羣困在其中。

programme.title: 美食足跡: 南非 #9
programme.desc: 華倫來到歷史名城比勒陀利亞,到訪當地農夫市集,與糕點師郎高斯一起製作扭麻條(南非糯冬甩)。

programme.title: 美食足跡: 南非 #10
programme.desc: 華倫在繁忙的約翰內斯堡的第一站就是充滿活力的索維託小鎮。導遊仙迪帶他乘坐篤篤車​​遊覽,並烹煮了他自己版本的一道南非素菜- 恰卡拉卡。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中國 #1
programme.desc: 廖崇明來到母親的家鄉北京,在中國這個古老國家開展烹飪、歷史和個人之旅。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中國 #2
programme.desc: 崇明參觀了山巒起伏的美麗省份- 安徽,這是中國八大菜系之一的故鄉。徽菜是誠懇的農家菜,採用時令山野食材烹調而成。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中國 #3

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中國 #4

programme.title: 生存邊緣 #2
programme.desc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅。從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險。

programme.title: 生存邊緣 #3
programme.desc: 《生存邊緣》探索一個近未來,人工智能統治著地球和我們。人工智能將伴隨我們一生,並帶來人類史上所面臨��最大存亡風險。

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Baxter is a Shih-Tzu that was discovered abandoned in an empty house on the outskirts of Manchester; thin and with extremely matted fur Inspector Lyndsey Taylor comes to the rescue, but until all that fur is removed, nobody knows what lies beneath

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #3

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #4
programme.desc: 強尼和卡門的情事進展順利,而丹尼爾和阿曼達則被泰瑞的陰謀搞得心神不寧。青少年們的恩怨延燒到了水上樂園。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #5
programme.desc: 丹尼爾依靠一位朋友——也是「亦敵亦友」的夥伴。米格爾和羅比的緊張關係達到頂點。一張熟悉的面孔回歸了。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #6
programme.desc: 泰瑞招募了一位精通「拳法之道」的專家。丹尼爾選擇遠離紛爭,強尼和喬善卻主動挑起戰火。在監獄裡,克里斯正視著內心的心魔。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #7
programme.desc: 泰瑞和金發起了一項殘酷的挑戰,而喬善則教導他的學生們不同的一課。強尼和丹尼爾要求克里斯給出交代。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #8
programme.desc: 一個爭奪國際頂尖賽事名額的機會引發了道館間的激戰。多莉的忠誠度受到考驗。珊則難以放下米格爾。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #9
programme.desc: 多莉為她的反抗付出了代價。魟魚正與他的良知搏鬥。強尼、丹尼爾和喬善在城裡的慶祝之夜發生了意外轉折。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #10
programme.desc: 山谷區爆發了一場決戰之夜,強尼、丹尼爾、喬善和他們的學生們集結了所有的技能與力量,誓要揭發並擊垮泰瑞。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #1
programme.desc: 強尼勞倫斯在輸掉全谷空手道錦標賽34年後,決定重開眼鏡蛇道場,而他學校的對手丹尼爾拉魯索則經營著一家成功的汽車公司。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #2
programme.desc: 丹尼爾沮喪地發現全新的眼鏡蛇道場已經開業。強尼瞭解到他的道場真正開始教學前必須通過幾項安全要求。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #3
programme.desc: 米格爾幫助強尼在網上宣傳眼鏡蛇道場。丹尼爾同意在萬聖節舞會上擔任監護人,以便可以看顧女兒。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #4
programme.desc: 羅比與父親關係緊張。強尼因米格爾受傷而計畫關閉眼鏡蛇道場。薩曼莎和凱勒的關係跌至谷底。被破壞的廣告板讓丹尼爾繃緊。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #5
programme.desc: 眼鏡蛇道場接收第二位學生。丹尼爾有一個複雜的計劃來報復強尼。米格爾在午休時為捍衛薩曼莎而對抗凱勒。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #6
programme.desc: 強尼的道場課吸引一羣不合的人,而他心懷不軌的兒子羅比則找到一份新工作。薩曼莎在科學課上結識一位新朋友。丹尼爾激發了一個意想不到的人對空手道的興趣。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #7
programme.desc: 強尼得知眼鏡蛇道場被禁止參加全谷錦標賽後跟市議會對質。米格爾約會薩曼莎。羅比向丹尼爾學習,而他的夥伴則策劃搶劫拉魯索汽車公司。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #8
programme.desc: 強尼為他的眼鏡蛇道場學生準備下一屆全谷空手道錦標賽,他也反過來受啟發去改過自新。丹尼爾還不知道他新學生的背景。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #9
programme.desc: 路易的魯莽行為逼使強尼和丹尼爾回憶往事。眼鏡蛇道場學生密謀對受歡迎的孩子進行報復。米格爾對薩曼莎慢慢失去耐性。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #10
programme.desc: 今天是2018年度全谷空手道錦標賽,眼鏡蛇道場決心取勝。羅比以獨立人士登記。一個舊臉孔回歸。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #1

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第三季) #8
programme.desc: 月島帶傷下場,由成田替補。烏野跟白鳥澤繼續纏鬥到搶分,眼見白鳥澤只要再得一分比賽就結束了。繫心教練一句大喊喚醒了眾人的鬥志。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第三季) #9
programme.desc: 第五局的局末點,同分。月島在這時候回到場上,兩隊又繼續廝殺。

programme.title: 海賊王女 #7
programme.desc: 為了救出菲娜,雪丸隻身一人從鰹魚2號離開。武士們苦於在島嶼紀律和菲娜之間做出抉擇,猶豫該從命返航回島上或打破紀律,作為海賊活下去。此時火爆玫瑰襲擊藍巨靈,冉冉升起的黑煙喚醒了菲娜本已忘卻的記憶。

programme.title: 海賊王女 #8
programme.desc: 武士們將菲娜從藍巨靈成功帶回來,雪丸卻在過程中受了重傷,為了治療他的傷勢,一行人在紗富彎街稍作停留。紫檀將菲娜稱作魔女後便離開。菲娜看到夥伴因自己而互相對立,開始煩惱是否該繼續旅行。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #10
programme.desc: 在茜因為嚴重的感冒差點倒下時,出現在她面前的山田把她送到診所看病。椿曾在另一款網路遊戲中與山田對戰,與他建立友誼。瞭解山田會與女性保持距離的椿儘管心中排斥喜歡上對方,但對他的感情卻逐漸變得深厚,山田在她心中的地位也日益增大。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #11
programme.desc: 在山田的照顧下茜從感冒中康復。久違地登入FOS後,她第一次與公會新成員椿的角色接觸。兩人組隊挑戰了最終頭目,但卻因為敵人防禦力太高而陷入困境,不過一同戰鬥的過程讓茜與椿的關係立刻變得親近。登出後茜打給山田,希望能獲得有關遊戲攻略的建議。

programme.desc: 決定向山田告白的茜將自己的決心告訴親友桃子和「琉璃姬」瑛太。茜無預警地來到山田的公寓,但面對急著要去補習班的山田,她始終無法說出心中的話。於是兩人約在補習班結束後再碰面,但突如其來的暴雨和椿衝動的行為讓當天的計畫被迫取消。

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #3
programme.desc: 在女性向遊戲中本該對反派千金冷感的杜克,卻莫名地對艾莉西亞這位想留名歷史的反派表露興趣。艾莉西亞雖然對他的舉動感到困惑,但沒有閒暇沉溺於戀愛的她,悄悄潛入了魔法學院。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #11
programme.desc: 眼看圭護的運動鞋就要被搶走時監志出手幫助了他。襲擊圭護的男人利用了具有興奮作用的珠珠糖增強自己的力量及慾望。據說散播珠珠糖的是人稱「狼」的人物,而使用珠珠糖作亂的那些人則被稱為「狗」。另一方面,自稱是魔女的宮尾音夢出現在妮可和守仁面前。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#66粵
programme.desc: 喜好友芳即將舉家回鄉，欲將生果店轉讓。喜舉行家庭會議，要求進軍生果店，惜眾人反對。喜無奈，決定私下購入生果店。喜私下到生果店實習，令藥房出現大混亂。眾家人見喜舉動異常，竟誤會她染上賭癮欠下巨債。

programme.title: 尚食#6粵普
programme.desc: 沒有獲升為典膳，紫萍大失所望。乾清宮走水，喻美人縱火被擒，莊妃受牽連被軟禁，子衿和紫萍偷偷為其送飯。喻氏供認太子指使自己下毒，眾人於聖前對質。子衿說出喻氏染疾一事，瞻基又發現關鍵證據，幫太子扭轉局勢。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 本地紅蔥頭味道香濃，用作配料或製作醬料同樣合適。鼎爺將海味、香料、醬料三大類材料放入攪拌器打蓉，再慢慢炒勻，「自家製沙茶醬」可謂零失敗！芥蘭取出蘭度，與嫩滑牛柳同炒，再加入沙茶醬調味，即成滋味菜式。火腩帶有油香，腓排亦具鮮味。「春菜排骨煲」的春菜吸盡兩種香味，更是精華所在。阿爺及後將蟹膏、蟹肉與肉餅拌勻，並一同蒸煮，帶來外觀、味道兼備的「膏蟹蒸肉餅」。將豬肉肉餅分別剁成蓉和碎粒，還有助提升口感。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 血壓測量到甚麼數字代表血壓高？心臟科醫生還提到，狀況有可能導致嚴重併發症！患者一般都要長期服藥，而降血壓藥分為五大類，需注意相關副作用。醫生亦提供有助預防高血壓的生活習慣建議。據指逾半數男性長者都有前列腺肥大問題，也擔憂會引致患癌，有甚麼相關檢查？前列腺肥大會壓住尿道致小便困難，如服藥療效欠理想，又有何新型手術可助病人解困？「睇餸食飯」，李家鋌師傅參考日式天婦羅的做法，炮製一道「金沙酒香杏鮑菇」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 汕頭之旅新一集，祖藍不止坐低等食，還提出要跟兩位頂流潮菜大師學藝，嘗試烹調幾道經典潮菜。大師給他的首要任務是買食材，「過海」、「帶靴」究竟是甚麼？展示「豆醬煮膏蟹」做法，不用刀徒手就可剝開蟹蓋，不愧為大師！還有「滷水乳鴿」、「鮮蝦釀吊瓜」，祖藍統統都學會了！入夜，祖藍走進火鍋店一試滷水火鍋，配鵝材同喫，夠濃味。不過，祖藍更推介店內的老菜脯粥底火鍋，也可配以鮮美的海鮮；但為何粥底內不見米飯？

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#18粵
programme.desc: 兆明日以繼夜照顧昏迷的司徒嵐，秀瓊看在眼內深受感動。曉盈買鑽石表獎勵自己坐上CEO位置，威龍提醒她無須爬到山頂。威龍帶麗娟探望秀瓊，秀瓊坦言要照顧女兒，同時不忘守護鼎福和。秀瓊看到兆明頹廢，曉以大義鼓勵他振作。百喜昇召開記招交代鼎福和未來發展，竇彰指收購的事仍未下定案。曉盈不滿威龍站在竇彰一方，威龍坦言在幫她。司徒嵐甦醒，卻完全失去對兆明的記憶，視他為陌路人；醫生指司徒嵐有可能永遠失去記憶……

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: 一織釐清陸的特質後，明白到是其哀求人的表情產生的效果，於是決心要令陸感到幸福滿足。大和等人上門探望TRIGGER，龍之介勸壯五與家人和好，環卻表現激動，更要出手打人，天見狀叫他一起出去買食物。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 人口普查收集人口數據，原來香港有團體推行「麻雀普查」？「Kids’ Notes」請來團體代表述說相關普查細節。在港可見的麻雀主要有三種，包括樹麻雀、家麻雀、山麻雀，各有甚麼特色？嘉賓還談及麻雀如何用乾沙「洗澡」。另外，香港不時有野鴿聚集，但原來大多都不是本地原生，而是外來物種？珠頸斑鳩則是香港原生雀鳥，頸上的斑點就是其特徵！常說「麻鷹捉雞仔」，麻鷹也會在天空盤旋尋找食物，但牠們的主要食糧並非雞仔？

programme.title: 天才高球少女粵日
programme.desc: 五十嵐誤信蜻蛉戲言，喫下山羊糞，成為島民笑柄。蜻蛉用高爾夫球桿打棒球，更把切刺身的方法應用到高球上，其控球技術再度令五十嵐驚訝。五十嵐發現蜻蛉缺乏鬥心，但他卻想讓對方參加比賽。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 週年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 油麻地有新盤交樓，窗邊防水膠條沒裝妥，地板也有罅隙及拱起，為何如此？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠臺每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 婆婆疑被路面沙井蓋絆倒而受傷，有關機構可有回應？長者乘車優惠將於4月3日起調整為「兩蚊兩折」，節目組搶先一探市民看法，並帶來精明乘車貼士。屯門某屋邨業主接獲管理處書信通知，指樓下投訴其單位喉管漏水，要求事主於限期內安排師傅檢查及維修。工程期間，事主向樓下住戶查詢，對方卻稱沒投訴兼沒漏水？管理處一方的回覆更令事主感到不滿！黎明於演唱會尾場，細說愛上音樂的由來，以及向樂迷送紅蘿蔔手燈的意義。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2776粵
programme.desc: Elaine偶然發現Venus向壯表白，壯則稱需要時間考慮再作答覆。Elaine與若水商議此事，被Ceci聽到，她建議Elaine寫情書表白。壯收到情書，終知悉Elaine的心意，滿心歡喜；原本一切順利，她卻因遺忘某事情而功虧一簣。Ceci再向她獻計，打算讓壯英雄救美，以製造表白機會。壯接到Elaine的訊息，得悉她有危險，竟未現身相救，也無回覆。Elaine懷疑壯正往見Venus，欲給她答覆……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#3粵PG
programme.desc: 邵文處理一宗家暴案，勾起自身回憶；童年的邵文與姊姊邵玲飽受母親毒打，邵玲為保護弟弟大義滅親。邵玲這次希望邵文的判決可令案中施暴父親付出代價，但事情其後出現變數……邵玲對邵文的判決感到不解，姊弟關係降至冰點。離島三少年在山頭活埋同學，此案由惠知接手審理。淑樺為其中一名被告辯護，提出三人只是受島上惡霸談卓飛唆擺作惡，犯案主謀應是卓飛。惠知、淑樺再次交鋒，二人都想起因麗慈母子而起的往事……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：機智女法醫2#20粵普PG
programme.desc: 玉瀾叫楚楚不要浪費時間，楚楚那邊的人到不了，但是他們的奇兵要到了。瑾璃帶人過來，路上遇到毒蟲，幸好楚楚早就研製出能驅散毒蟲的藥粉。祐辰安三人跑進廟裡，楚楚等人驅散毒蟲後再進去時，他們已經從地道跑了。

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈獻：轟炸味蕾的廚房粵
programme.desc: 「90後女廚師」鄭紫欣擅長煮西餐，看過西安人製作當地的特色油潑麵後靈感迸發，加入西式食材，做出「西班牙辣肉腸蒜蝦肉燥麵」。紫欣顯技即席拉麵條，還應要求邊拉麵邊轉身，猶如某餐廳的師傅親臨表演，功架十足。蹺腳牛肉是四川樂山市在地美食，啟發家鋌師傅帶來「沸藤清湯牛腩」。粵菜中用蘿蔔、香料等燜煮的清湯腩，食用前淋上加熱的花椒油，能提升香氣層次。烹調過程中，祖儀這廚壇新手又發出甚麼妙語，讓師傅無言以對？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#36粵
programme.desc: 少龍偷入魏營救秦兵，暴露了身分，幸得龍陽君相救。此時信陵君率眾來搜，還取出魏王的御賜金牌……廷芳與善柔在渡頭救起漂浮江中的人，認出是少龍。廷芳自稱鳳菲，不肯跟少龍相認。不韋取笑嬴政將多出一個便宜弟郎，嬴政怒氣沖沖到大鄭宮，太醫指出朱姬有了身孕。嬴政要嫪毐護送不韋往巡視長城，伺機殺他。嬴政強行灌朱姬飲墮胎湯藥時，趙高突然來報指嫪毐事敗，嬴政為怕觸怒不韋，任由他處置嫪毐。嫪毐強忍劇痛，喫力爬上高樓。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#66粵
programme.desc: 喜好友芳即將舉家回鄉，欲將生果店轉讓。喜舉行家庭會議，要求進軍生果店，惜眾人反對。喜無奈，決定私下購入生果店。喜私下到生果店實習，令藥房出現大混亂。眾家人見喜舉動異常，竟誤會她染上賭癮欠下巨債。

programme.title: 尚食#6粵普
programme.desc: 沒有獲升為典膳，紫萍大失所望。乾清宮走水，喻美人縱火被擒，莊妃受牽連被軟禁，子衿和紫萍偷偷為其送飯。喻氏供認太子指使自己下毒，眾人於聖前對質。子衿說出喻氏染疾一事，瞻基又發現關鍵證據，幫太子扭轉局勢。

programme.title: Sunday靚聲王粵
programme.desc: 蔣志光與韋綺姍再度合唱<相逢何必曾相識，人氣不減當年！湯寶如夥拍後輩關楚耀合唱一曲，還與蔣志光合唱其首本名曲<相思風雨中。彭健新、林欣彤、馮允謙、文佩玲、胡渭康亦以不同方式配搭，演唱經典合唱歌曲。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵

高朋滿座#67粵
programme.desc: 溢看戲時與妄顧公德的惡霸爭論，反被惡霸以歪理迫她道歉。但此事卻被拍成短片放於網上，溢訴苦，朋教溢向慶學「人善人欺天不欺」。溢到遊戲中心找尋慶，但溢竟又再遇上惡人，這次慶替他挺身而出，最終成功趕走惡霸。

programme.title: 尚食#7粵普
programme.desc: 漢王看到遊一帆拜祭亡母，認出他是失蹤多年之子。胡善圍扭傷腳，唯有子衿願去送飯，令其對子衿頗為欣賞，願加以提攜。王遙清收月華為徒，兩人一起完善失傳古譜。紫萍在寒風中跪地一夜，終令孟尚食答應讓她再入庖廚。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 主持們登上小艇，享用「避風塘」招牌炒肉蟹、炒蜆美食，鼎爺還提起避風塘上的第一次約會。鼎爺購入一隻大龍蝦，起殼後要阿譚將龍蝦殼及蝦殼一起熬煮，做出濃蝦湯來炒伊麵。備用的龍蝦肉則連同荷蘭豆、百合、白玉木耳等配菜一起爆炒，鑊氣十足！二人另到果園摘香蕉，暢談香蕉適宜食用的時機。返回廚房，沒有蕉葉，轉用荷葉鋪上蒸籠，巧製一道「荷葉粉蒸肉」。阿譚想採用糯米粉替代炒勻糯米及粘米，卻未為拍檔接受，有何原因？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 癌症骨轉移是指癌細胞由其他組織擴散至骨骼，常見於乳癌、肺癌與前列腺癌。臨牀腫瘤科醫生提到這病或會引致病理性骨折等併發症，並詳析治標與治本的治療方案。逆境智商(AQ)是衡量人的抗壓與復原能力，精神科醫生以汽車零件作比喻，形象化解說IQ、EQ與AQ之別， AQ高的孩子普遍能較樂觀地面對困難。嘉賓亦帶來提升AQ四部曲，還建議家長透過遊戲、故事討論協助孩子訓練。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨師傅炮製「香葉三杯蝦」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 祖藍漫步汕頭的商業區，與香港的中環氣氛大不同，同時亦蘊藏了一些當地特色美食。有雪糕店旨在創出新穎口味，以鴨屎香呈現汕頭獨有的雪糕味道之餘，另一款加入苦瓜的雪糕更是得獎之作！祖藍常讚汕頭牛好味，用新鮮牛肉造成漢堡扒，再以鹹菜代替酸瓜，製作出汕頭特色漢堡，既前衛又不覺味道奇怪；還有一款魷魚漢堡？汕頭有餐廳熬製雞煲湯底時分別加入百香果、木薑子，零舍開胃！店主更推介一款「糯米烤雞」，最不能錯過的是雞皮？

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#19粵PG
programme.desc: 司徒邦送司徒嵐玉珮，表示愛她的人永遠守護她。曉盈帶助手到鼎福和上班，一班員工有意刁難，但曉盈有備而來。秀瓊分別送紅酒和下酒食物給竇彰與德正，盼兩父子和好。兆明得知曉盈被中介商瞞騙，購入過期黃豆。曉盈抱怨威龍千方百計阻止她收購鼎福和，威龍反拿出鑽石戒指求婚……司徒嵐埋首會計工作，兆明傳短訊逗她開心。司徒嵐被兆明的經歷感動，但對他仍然沒有感覺，決定離開他。秀瓊對司徒嵐不再寫小說、結束咖啡店深感不安……

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: 壯五拿著資料去遊說環讓他回家，環最終放行。ZOOL上去《Next Re:vale》做嘉賓，前半段一言不發，虎於企圖用筆嚇千卻被百反制，四人屈服配合節目進行，事後百把電話號碼交給對方。壯五回到家裡，與父親對峙。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」再次展開，Ban Sir率先帶領大家進行基礎體適能訓練。他指出，這些動作能有效提升協調、反應與速度，不僅有助日常運動表現，對做家務、行樓梯亦大有裨益。此外，小朋友亦可透過踢腿、交叉步等動作，增強平衡力與下肢肌肉。節目還會播出AI生成動畫《星星的銀幣》的下半部份，大家也要學習故事內小女孩的無私愛心，向身邊人傳遞溫暖和關懷。

programme.title: 祕密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 同學七海拾到一個星光兔的袋子，走來詢問陽葵是否她的，就在這時，另一位同學鈴夢則說這個袋子是她妹妹的，還強調自己身為模特兒對星光兔沒興趣。儘管如此，陽葵還是想和鈴夢交朋友，二人更開始熟絡起來……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 糖尿病是常見的都市病，在西方國家很普通，越來越多香港人亦患上此病，部分人甚至不知道已患上糖尿病，其實糖尿病就是人體的胰臟，不能分泌足夠的胰島素，或者胰島素失去應有的功能，新聞掏寶和大家重溫1991年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠臺每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2777粵
programme.desc: 敢威、尚善與力蓮碰巧同時休假，無法聯絡得上。某項目臨時改為公開招標，作為最高決策人的璟風遂召集相關人員商議可要調整標價，卻未有定論，幸有人想到拖延之策。為免再出現高層真空狀況，璟風建議預早請假並互通消息，獲敢威同意。敢威打算兩星期後乘郵輪度假，怎料力蓮、尚善已申請休假，還似乎勢在必行，他只好取消行程，家聰卻提出另類解決方案。敢威對主管及以上級別推行新請假政策，意圖阻止力蓮休假，卻引發不少問題……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#4粵PG
programme.desc: 「離島三害案」尋回的兇器上，證實還有卓飛的DNA。惠知打算調查「第四名疑犯」卓飛的去向，並要求邵玲幫忙，終發現驚人內情。回到庭上，在惠知與檢控官林雅晴的追問下，最終揭出案件的殘酷真相！惠知藉判詞指出家長盲目包庇，令犯罪少年一錯再錯，淑樺聽出其用意，心情鬱悶。光正之女邱天雪，希望促成父親與惠知和好，卻事與願違。淑樺接到保鏢通知，指成彬不知去向，令淑樺大為緊張……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：機智女法醫2#21粵普PG
programme.desc: 冷月帶著藥材來交州支援楚楚，並幫忙用止痛粉替病人去掉壁蝨，楚楚從中得到啟發，決定剖腹取蟲。祐辰安在兩國和談上設局刺殺祐龍晟，又用藥使南趙王病重，趁機代理朝政。得知藥材不足，楚父便動身前往山貨市集採買。

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈獻：轟炸味蕾的廚房粵
programme.desc: 在四川，臘肉會加甚麼香料醃製？當地人還會故意把臘肉燒到變焦，再颳走表面燒焦一層，所為何事？世韜師傅概述四川臘肉與廣式臘肉之別，隨後用不同臘肉、臘腸炮製「四川臘味煲仔飯」；臘味頭頭尾尾亦不浪費，連同冰糖、生抽、老抽來煮出煲仔飯豉油，絕對夠美味！遼寧本溪有過百間賣烤豆皮的店舖，食材廉價簡單，濃味好喫的背後卻是工序多多！人氣女主廚紫欣教觀眾在家輕鬆「複製」，奉上「煙燻烤豆皮」，但對祖儀來說似乎不易……

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#37粵
programme.desc: 嫪毐以嬴政身世祕密要脅他確保一家三口安全。廷芳心緒不寧，排舞錯漏百出，少龍教她跳西班牙舞，二人關係轉好。廷芳在齊王面前表演後，突然有殺手跳出刺殺齊王，劍劃過廷芳的背。廷芳自知中毒垂危，向少龍剖白愛意，少龍承諾待她復元後娶她。少龍推測齊相田單籌劃刺殺行動，與善柔夜探田府，揭穿主公是齊墨鉅子曹秋道，秋道以善柔性命及解藥交換鉅子令祕笈。嫪毐與嬴政探望朱姬，嬴政的態度和善，原來嫪毐找來假嬴政密謀頂包秦王。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 癌症骨轉移是指癌細胞由其他組織擴散至骨骼，常見於乳癌、肺癌與前列腺癌。臨牀腫瘤科醫生提到這病或會引致病理性骨折等併發症，並詳析治標與治本的治療方案。逆境智商(AQ)是衡量人的抗壓與復原能力，精神科醫生以汽車零件作比喻，形象化解說IQ、EQ與AQ之別， AQ高的孩子普遍能較樂觀地面對困難。嘉賓亦帶來提升AQ四部曲，還建議家長透過遊戲、故事討論協助孩子訓練。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨師傅炮製「香葉三杯蝦」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 祖藍漫步汕頭的商業區，與香港的中環氣氛大不同，同時亦蘊藏了一些當地特色美食。有雪糕店旨在創出新穎口味，以鴨屎香呈現汕頭獨有的雪糕味道之餘，另一款加入苦瓜的雪糕更是得獎之作！祖藍常讚汕頭牛好味，用新鮮牛肉造成漢堡扒，再以鹹菜代替酸瓜，製作出汕頭特色漢堡，既前衛又不覺味道奇怪；還有一款魷魚漢堡？汕頭有餐廳熬製雞煲湯底時分別加入百香果、木薑子，零舍開胃！店主更推介一款「糯米烤雞」，最不能錯過的是雞皮？

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#19粵PG
programme.desc: 司徒邦送司徒嵐玉珮，表示愛她的人永遠守護她。曉盈帶助手到鼎福和上班，一班員工有意刁難，但曉盈有備而來。秀瓊分別送紅酒和下酒食物給竇彰與德正，盼兩父子和好。兆明得知曉盈被中介商瞞騙，購入過期黃豆。曉盈抱怨威龍千方百計阻止她收購鼎福和，威龍反拿出鑽石戒指求婚……司徒嵐埋首會計工作，兆明傳短訊逗她開心。司徒嵐被兆明的經歷感動，但對他仍然沒有感覺，決定離開他。秀瓊對司徒嵐不再寫小說、結束咖啡店深感不安……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#67粵
programme.desc: 溢看戲時與妄顧公德的惡霸爭論，反被惡霸以歪理迫她道歉。但此事卻被拍成短片放於網上，溢訴苦，朋教溢向慶學「人善人欺天不欺」。溢到遊戲中心找尋慶，但溢竟又再遇上惡人，這次慶替他挺身而出，最終成功趕走惡霸。

programme.title: 尚食#7粵普
programme.desc: 漢王看到遊一帆拜祭亡母，認出他是失蹤多年之子。胡善圍扭傷腳，唯有子衿願去送飯，令其對子衿頗為欣賞，願加以提攜。王遙清收月華為徒，兩人一起完善失傳古譜。紫萍在寒風中跪地一夜，終令孟尚食答應讓她再入庖廚。

programme.title: 大玩特玩粵
programme.desc: 壓軸一玩，在婚宴場地玩一番，由「垃圾之最」連詩雅、朱智賢鬥倒黴抽隊員，兩人的行為總是令人摸不著頭腦。大玩隊與特玩隊進行一對一單挑，蝦頭與楊潮凱造就「同姓一吻」；陳嘉桓、林秀怡竟出動肥肉搶鏡；翟威廉與朱智賢大鬥反應，威廉勝出卻輸風度！「開口中」遊戲談起情侶間的暱稱，眾人戀情被Bob擺上檯，為何最後區永權要接受喫辣飯的懲罰？藝員搶花球爭獎品，有甚麼東西令蝦頭感動流涕？慰勞宴上，眾人分享最難忘的事。

programme.title: 同屋企人去旅行粵
programme.desc: 關楓馨首次單獨和爸爸關禮傑去旅行，安排了海景酒店，希望可一起看日出。兩人先挑戰揚帆出海，父女合作操控風帆，漸見默契。楓馨又帶爸爸夜遊惠州年輕人蒲點，嘗試夾公仔，也換上泳裝享受溫泉樂。翌日享用早餐後，父女登高觀賞雙月灣美景，還駕駛越野車漫遊沙灘。楓馨特意為爸爸準備內地網紅最新的打卡活動— 圍爐煮茶，兩人互相替對方拍照，傑爸的攝影姿勢與技術卻似乎被嫌棄！入夜，父女摸着酒杯深入對談，楓馨緣何觸動落淚？

programme.title: 同屋企人去旅行粵
programme.desc: 楓馨偕爸爸獨遊，擔心媽媽會呷醋，因此親自調製香水送贈母親「補飛」。及後和爸爸會合喫飯，楓馨還溫馨餵他進食。關氏父女接着以高卡車競速分勝負，完賽後談感受，傑哥一份感動湧上心頭，所為何事？來到惠州的海鮮街大擦一頓，父女互相點菜許諾回家後為對方下廚。惠州之行臨近尾聲，楓馨要求爸爸為她策劃的這次旅程評分，竟只得八十分？父女兩人又會訴說對這趟旅程的感受、得着，傑哥還暗中為女兒準備了一份窩心禮物，會是甚麼？

programme.title: 高朋滿座#68粵
programme.desc: 情進入義的公司後，兄妹感情大進。義一反懶惰本性，教授她辦公室生存之道。義將德下屬德安解僱，情竟將有義視為機密的「公司人物關係表」送給德安。義大怒，指責有情專門與他作對，有情反脣相譏，兩兄妹竟因此吵翻。

programme.title: 尚食#8粵普
programme.desc: 子衿勸說朱瞻基原諒太孫妃，不料二人誤會更深，朱瞻基對子衿發洩怨氣，子衿決定以奴婢對待主人的方式待之。朱瞻基等人品鑒尚食局為外國使節團準備的菜品，有別於其他人呈上各樣山珍海味，子衿偏偏呈上尋常食物。

programme.title: 香港本色粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 金雕、玉雕、牙雕已成夕陽行業，一班手藝非凡的老師傅，如何為這些傳統工藝「守尾門」？一塊金磚，由熔金到打磨，每個步驟都要一絲不苟，打金師傅胡文楷卻稱學習了「批、鑲、卓、鑿」已稱得上滿師，但要怎樣才能獨當一面？經過師傅悉心設計，一塊石頭，隨時會變成價值連成的寶玉！何以香蕉、燒肉、龍蝦等亦能成為精緻的玉器擺設？牙雕業在國際實施象牙禁運後面臨重大衝擊，何以朱忠盛仍堅持守護這門即將絕跡的手藝？

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺與阿譚到塔門與漁民捉海鮮，有甚麼收穫？接着鼎爺以海膽蒸蛋白及炒飯，將原片海膽與蛋白同蒸，想蛋白蒸起來更幼滑有何祕訣？鼎爺製作炒飯時特意選用蛋白帶出海膽的鮮味，為何海膽要分兩次下鑊？鼎爺與阿譚品嚐過塔門住家菜，再帶來兩道海鮮菜式。先炮製「鮑魚綠豆沙」，這道「豪華」糖水有何來歷？糖水中的「西米棟楝」是甚麼？鼎爺又以荷包魷切幼絲，配搭蝦醬、蔬菜炒麵，留意下材料的先後次序，令魷魚嫩滑不致韌。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 老花是眼睛自然退化的現象，難以躲避，故應學懂好好應對處理。近視與老花，會互相抵消嗎？眼科醫生建議選用老花漸進鏡或老花隱形眼鏡，如未能適應，也有兩個主要手術方案可供選擇，詳情如何？跟復活節相關之物，如兔子、復活蛋、紅蘿蔔，都可成為復活節特別造型甜品的題材。五星級酒店糕餅總廚展示作品之餘，還會即席示範「復活節榛果朱古力慕絲盆栽」的製作步驟。至於「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅烹調一道「蝦子腐皮素雞」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 有三兄弟繼承了父親的砂鍋粥路邊攤，發展成砂鍋粥店，更標明即點即煮即宰。粥內有肉蟹、鮑魚、蟶子，足料非常，也滿載鮮味；椒鹽鷓鴣等伴粥小菜亦不容錯過！踏進小喫街，祖藍又有任務了！買齊反沙番薯芋、無米粿、鱟粿、橄欖油甘甘蔗汁、酸菜豬肚湯五種小食，認識小喫歷史之外，還找來小朋友為他現場即學的潮汕話評分呢！祖藍接着到步行街逛夜市，順道為家中三位女士搜羅禮物，有檔主專誠為祖藍兩位千金設計簡單名牌，不得不買啦！

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#20粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)竇彰盼曉盈將五成半股權賣回給竇家，讓他們延續傳統精神。百喜昇受醜聞影響，股價不斷下跌。司徒嵐忽然記起《哥士的殺手》故事內容及意外情景，頭痛不已。秀瓊認錯鄰家是自己的家，兆明提議她做檢查。蔣生要曉盈對鼎福和事件負全責，並將鼎福和的股份全賣回竇家。竇彰邀同業加入鼎福和，各人表示愛莫能助……德正參加沙沙舞比賽被美娜奚落，仍堅持站在舞臺，並找來丹丹做舞伴。兆明帶秀瓊看醫生，證實她患腦退化症……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子隨爸爸晚上巡區提高防火意識，事後到居酒屋小休，其間得以窺探成年人的世界。小玉不小心弄壞盛載其父母回憶的音樂盒，去鐘錶店找人修理但不果，小丸子提議她學習用鋼琴把曲子彈奏出來。

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: 壯五向父親說出內心想法，但後者不理，更藉故誣陷環傷人，要脅壯五放棄演藝活動。壯五獨個兒主持電臺節目，其間透露自己的過去，更播出TRIGGER的歌。環前來迎接壯五，在車上告訴他其父親已答允請求。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 復活節有甚麼象徵物件？導師在「Artspiration」教大家繪畫色彩繽紛的應節元素。畫紙右方有一個籃，用來盛起不同大小、顏色的復活蛋；至於左方及籃後，都可以畫出可愛得意、耳朵長長的復活兔。跟着導師的指引，繪畫過程相信會容易得多。如小朋友遇到一些困難的事情，經「開心SHARE」過後，說不定也可找到輕鬆面對的方法！主持們是怎樣克服數學功課與課堂作文的「難關」？Emily姐姐還試過以跳舞代替部份默書？

programme.title: 祕密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 美月在早晨直播時，說起「想趁今年內做到的事」，陽葵希望自己的廚藝有所進步，而美月則想克服最害怕的跳箱。陽葵見狀，決定為美月進行特訓，可是美月仍然對跳箱充滿恐懼，怎麼都跳不過去……

programme.title: Kiki & Nuna 知識寶庫粵普
programme.desc: 在小鎮上生活著六個小朋友，在他們的日常生活中，會遇到形形色色的問題，有朋友之間的情感問題，有生活中的安全問題，有待人處事的行為規範，美妙世界的科學原理

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 週年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 日出康城一個1,500平方呎單位，如何把中式古董收藏品，融入現代設計風格？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠臺每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2778粵
programme.desc: 樹根生日將至，適逢他擔任金剛門掌門十週年，打算邀請各地分館門人參與壽宴。城安等人忙於安排各項事宜，卻知悉樹根任期將滿，快將退位，懷疑他大事舖張另有所圖。聯絡海外門人並不順利，樹根責怪眾人辦事不力。尚善託潮偉查得海外多間分館已結束，門人四散，眾人於是取消壽宴，改為自行慶祝。生日當天，樹根以為壽宴如期舉行，滿心期待，眾人只好設法補救。出於某些原因，樹根被困家中。得悉麻煩盡消，眾人欣喜之際卻另有發現……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#5粵PG
programme.desc: 惠知審理一宗盜竊案，被告竟是當日意外開槍擊斃麗慈的警員何偉迪……偉迪一直愧疚，終鼓起勇氣探望麗慈的遺孤芳芳，偉迪再向惠知探問案件真相。邵文的母親冼勵梅被指「碰瓷」扮撞車敲詐，而被告上法庭，邵文自覺顏面無存，勵梅卻毫無悔意！凍肉店發現初生嬰兒屍體，女店主的女兒麥珊珊被控殺嬰罪，珊珊卻堅持不說出嬰兒爸爸是誰，裁判官洪思義覺得另有內情。宇澤的忌日，惠知往現場拜祭時，與淑樺狹路相逢……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：機智女法醫2#22粵普PG
programme.desc: 辰安派人抓走楚平以威逼楚楚前往南趙，進而迫使瑾瑜答應出使南趙重啟和談。瑾瑜見虛弱的南趙王完全受制於辰安，看出其想借大唐之力順利繼位之野心,便暗示藩王未死，無法強行冊封，另一邊廂瑾瑜又祕密約見李璋…

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈獻：轟炸味蕾的廚房粵
programme.desc: 透過片段瞭解雲南傣族的孔雀宴後，小儀師傅嘗試以「焗爐燒腩仔」重現碳火烤肉的美味。她用焗爐烤出香脆外皮，還分享保持肉汁的祕訣，關鍵是一張紙巾。另邊廂，祖儀不僅向永權敬「流水酒」，還唱歌助興？雲南西雙版納盛產茶葉，以茶入饌更是當地特色。家鋌師傅借鑑煮出「茶燻祕製豉油雞」，以茶燻香氣轟炸主持們的味蕾！想不到只需茶葉、白米、砂糖三種材料，就可帶來滋味效果。此外，祖儀好學詢問生抽、豉油的分別，卻釀成笑話？

programme.desc: 嬴政野心勃勃，計劃十年內一統六國。嬴政將剛離母體的嬰兒掐死。嫪毐怒然挾持嬴政欲殺他，嬴政與趙高雙雙跳崖。少龍突然心緒不寧，再見銅鏡中影像模糊。嫪毐將真正兒子交給朱姬，原來他早已調包嬰兒。不韋見嬴政與朱姬突然關係轉好，隱覺不妥。琴清得悉少龍無恙回來，飛奔往渡頭接他，見他與廷芳態度親暱，錯愕。少龍奇怪二女沒有酸風醋雨。少龍更衣入宮時，赫見嬴政暱藏房中。嬴政講出調包原委，滕翼來報指琴清被大王軟禁。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 老花是眼睛自然退化的現象，難以躲避，故應學懂好好應對處理。近視與老花，會互相抵消嗎？眼科醫生建議選用老花漸進鏡或老花隱形眼鏡，如未能適應，也有兩個主要手術方案可供選擇，詳情如何？跟復活節相關之物，如兔子、復活蛋、紅蘿蔔，都可成為復活節特別造型甜品的題材。五星級酒店糕餅總廚展示作品之餘，還會即席示範「復活節榛果朱古力慕絲盆栽」的製作步驟。至於「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅烹調一道「蝦子腐皮素雞」。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#68粵
programme.desc: 情進入義的公司後，兄妹感情大進。義一反懶惰本性，教授她辦公室生存之道。義將德下屬德安解僱，情竟將有義視為機密的「公司人物關係表」送給德安。義大怒，指責有情專門與他作對，有情反脣相譏，兩兄妹竟因此吵翻。

programme.title: 尚食#8粵普
programme.desc: 子衿勸說朱瞻基原諒太孫妃，不料二人誤會更深，朱瞻基對子衿發洩怨氣，子衿決定以奴婢對待主人的方式待之。朱瞻基等人品鑒尚食局為外國使節團準備的菜品，有別於其他人呈上各樣山珍海味，子衿偏偏呈上尋常食物。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 日日運動身體好，吳幸美竟教跆拳道學員「洗面盆學游泳」、「牀下底踢毽」？原來是為了講解「㜺鬼」歇後語。廣東道玉器街是香港七十年代的熱門「蒲點」，主持們到訪玉器店學習分辨玉器優劣，期間發現「玉器塗白漆－ 內中有寶」？農曆七月初七又叫「七姐節」、「乞巧節」，背後除了牛郎織女的深情故事，還另有文章！霓虹燈製作過程繁複，「楷師傅」三兩下手勢便做出「TVB光管」，果然是「半空中點燈－ 高招」！

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 「盂蘭節」是中國傳統的「鬼節」，善信自會備好各式祭品「做節」。眾主持前往餅店尋找「文化遺產」，幸美卻帶來探險裝備，可謂「抬棺材甩褲－ 失禮死人」。鄭寶鴻另會講解「拋三牲」、「散福」等習俗。洋服店老闆逾四十年來堅持手做西裝，功架十足堪稱「飛機上點燈－ 高明」。張惠雅還向老闆請教何謂「關公領」、「飛機領」，以及時下流行的西裝款式。「擔屎唔偷食」意指為人忠直老實，俗語背後原來隱藏自明朝流傳至今的誤解！

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰纔是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰纔是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君(完)
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰纔是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰纔是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛祕。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰纔是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

Kent flies Edison’s Awesomobile to France to meet Sheila, but he is mistaken for an alien in a UFO, and the Team Kids must rescue him from an Area 51-type base.

programme.title: Mellodees - Hickory Dickory Dock - EP12

programme.title: Casper the Friendly Ghost - Casper the Friendly Ghost Ep10 - EP110
programme.desc: Depressed by the antics of the other ghosts, Casper leaves home to make friends. After unintentionally scaring several potential pals, Casper befriends two young children. They take him home, where Casper frightens their mother. Casper is again upset because he believes that he will always scare away his potential buddies. However, Casper scares away a banker who is coming to foreclose on the woman's house, and this wins her heart for Casper.

programme.title: Shaq's Garage - Ground Control to Biggie D - EP107

programme.title: Kids' Planet - Humility - EP112
programme.desc: In this episode, we will learn the importance of humility. We will understand how to have good sportsmanship and respect the efforts of your opponent. We will learn that with humility we can put aside arrogance and anger. We will also discover that there is no problem in asking for help from others because in doing so, that is also an act of humility.

programme.title: Kids' Planet - Responsibility - EP113

programme.title: A Murder Of Crows Hush Little Baby
programme.desc: After a lantern parade, two-year-old Paulina is found missing from her room. The chilling kidnapping hurls Investigator Martin Bruhl back into a sleepless nightmare he experienced two years ago.

programme.title: Adventures In The Land Of Asha
programme.desc: After 9-year-old Jules is banned from school because of his rare skin disease, his greatest wish is to be cured. He meets a mysterious new friend, Asha, after his dog runs away into the forest. Together, they go on an adventure to find a cure for him.

programme.title: Sima's Song
programme.desc: In 1970s Afghanistan, best friends Suraya and Sima are torn apart by political upheaval. Suraya is a wealthy communist and Sima is a traditional singer, and though their paths diverge, their enduring bond proves stronger than ideology.

programme.title: Pure White
programme.desc: Vural, a husband and a father who was raised in faith, leads a seemingly pious and conformist life. Yet, everything takes a sudden dark turn when he learns a truth that will force him to confront his views on religion and morality.

programme.title: Silent Screams
programme.desc: A young doctor is confronted with bad cases of abused children. She is shocked at how complicated it is to hold parents accountable. When a baby is killed, she decides to take a more active role, risking her medical license and her own life.

programme.title: A Murder Of Crows A Vigilante Justice
programme.desc: When a ransom demand suddenly appears, the disappearance of 19-year-old Tim Jatzkowski is now a cause of concern. While the boy’s father wants the police to rescue him, inspector Martin Brühl tries to convince his family to pay the ransom.

programme.title: Murders in Amboise
programme.desc: When a violinist is found murdered near da Vinci’s tomb in a pose similar to The Vitruvian Man, Captain Alban Dutertre returns home to investigate. As more da Vinci-inspired killings follow, he and Bérénice Amarillo link this to a missing young artist.

programme.title: Three Quarter Moon
programme.desc: Hartmut, a taxi-driver, is left in a bitter slump when his wife leaves him. That is, until he gets six-year-old Hayat and her mother in his taxi. In a serendipitous turn of events, Hayat is left under his care and she helps him learn to enjoy life again.

programme.title: Timeline
programme.desc: A romantic reunion turns into a life-or-death game of secrets and survival, where the past cannot stay hidden.

programme.title: Confetti
programme.desc: Due to her dyslexia, Meimei is ostracized by her school and community. Encouraged by Meimei's teacher from school, Lan leaves everything behind in China for New York City in hopes of finding an education program for her daughter.

programme.title: A Far Shore
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Aoi is an underage mother struggling to make ends meet and dealing with her husband’s violent temper. After her husband loses his job, their continuous fights lead them to a social downfall.

programme.title: Almost Entirely A Slight Disaster
programme.desc: In contemporary Istanbul, four youths in their twenties find themselves brought together by chance. Restless, disillusioned, and searching for direction, the four characters go face to face with the anxieties of their generation.

programme.title: Free Money
programme.desc: Based on true stories of the crypto and investment craze of the early 2020-ies. Crypto's allure, wealth's pursuit, and the lessons of a changing financial world collide in an intense journey of three interconnected lives - an unwitting Bitcoin holder, a crypto entrepreneur and a conservative banker.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Fossil Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels are digging in the garden when they come across a fossil, so Duggee and Narrator explain all about fossils and prehistoric times.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Footprint Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels are playing hide-and-seek, but they can't find Happy. The squirrels follow lots of different footprints that take them to their friend but there is one set they can't work out.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Juice Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is going to make the squirrels juice from the garden. Whilst picking the fruit, the squirrels meet a little bug, full of woes about being too small.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Gua Rusa, Borneo
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch discovers his Halloween pumpkin isn't as big as the Grimbots' one, he goes in search of some fertilizer to help it grow.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Go Jet Academy: Wind Power
programme.desc: The team race to save Glitch when his kite flies too close to the academy's windfarm.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S23) - Free The Roads
programme.desc: Bulgy thinks that people should travel by bus instead of rail, that is until he tries carrying all their passengers.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Outside Outside
programme.desc: The Shallots want to explore beyond the front garden, so Sarah comes up with a plan.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - The Mouse's Birthday
programme.desc: Sarah's hoping for a nice quiet birthday, but there's no chance once her friends arrive.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Circus
programme.desc: The circus bus has broken down, but the children are waiting for a circus show! Can Stanley help out?

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Stuck
programme.desc: Stanley has to free Myrtle, who is stuck, using his new tunnelling mole machine so she can attend the schools tree planting day.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals (S1) - My Grandad Sometimes Steals My Chocolate Buttons
programme.desc: From tickles and piggybacks to no longer being able to do cartwheels, grandparents are brilliant!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time to Hear an Orchestra
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are at the concert hall to hear some very special Captain Chloe music.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Musical Statues
programme.desc: At the end of a long day, Bluey and her family are out of sync and out of sorts, so Mum gets everyone to play musical statues.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Stories
programme.desc: Indy thinks she's no good because her model horse looks like a cow, but Calypso encourages her not to give up, so she tries to fix it with a little help from Winton.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Puppets
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo teach Unicorse good manners so he can ask Mum on a date, but things go awry when Unicorse eats a tick.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Island Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels are out doing a bit of sailing. What fun! When Tag starts to feel a little bit seasick Duggee suggests a stop off at the Island for a spot of lunch, but where's all the food?

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Voice Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels start talking to each other in the wrong voices it's clear something has gone awry. But Duggee has his voice badge. He knows what to do!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Stick Time
programme.desc: How many siblings does Norrie have? What's Duggee's favourite badge? What does everyone do on Fridays? Squirrel Club has the answers!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Go Jet Academy: Volcanic Island
programme.desc: There's trouble erupting for the Go Jetters as Glitch disturbs an underwater volcano...

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Parsley
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits Theatre, Parsley sings a rock song.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Pepper
programme.desc: Pepper performs a bell ringing act.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Broccoli Flies Again

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Tin Can Games

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Blow

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S3) - Wobbly Tower
programme.desc: When Mayor Oki wants to build a new tower, Messy is keen to help. There is just one problem - all his towers fall over...

programme.desc: When Bluey and Bingo are unable to grab a prize on a Magic Claw machine, Mum and Dad create their own version at home. But Dad isn't about to make winning easy.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Operation Jewel
programme.desc: Evil Pea steals Tomato's precious jewel. Supertato ventures to get it back by secretly lifting the jewel from Evil Pea's crown and defeating a crowd of rampaging Mini Peas.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Spot the Difference Badge
programme.desc: Duggee looks different, but what is it? By playing some looking games, the Squirrels learn how best to spot the difference.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - Happy's First Day
programme.desc: Happy has always loved the water. But while swimming around in his paddling pool at the playhouse, Duggee reminds the Squirrels that there was a time when Happy feared water!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Ladybird's Gameshow
programme.desc: Spot the odd one out or guess who lives here. A great memory tip from Duggee, an edition of The Agony and Eggstacy, and how to draw Enid - down to her last whisker.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Avenue of the Baobabs, Madagascar
programme.desc: GrimHQ crashes into the Baobab trees. Can the Go Jetters rescue a baby lemur in time?

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Venice, Italy
programme.desc: The Go Jetters get a sinking feeling when Glitch turns the canals of Venice into roads.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Seattle Space Needle, USA
programme.desc: The team goes where no Go Jetter has gone before, when Glitch tries to launch into space.

programme.title: My World Kitchen (S1) - Sienna's Nigerian Jollof Rice
programme.desc: Sienna is cooking Nigerian Jollof Rice. Sienna's dad has prepared a colourful Nigerian salad to eat with the rice and they have treated their guests to some Nigerian 'chin chin' too.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures (S1) - Emperor Penguins
programme.desc: Andy takes Kip on a wild adventure to see emperor penguins in Antarctica. He huddles up in a group of penguins to try and stay warm, and even finds a cosy spot under one of the parents.

programme.title: Swashbuckle (S7) - Rhyming Lurgy
programme.desc: In this episode the new pirates Sandy and Seaweed have caught the rhyming lurgy of the Ancient Mariner and can only speak in rhyme!

programme.title: Panda and Krash (S1) - Big Babysitting
programme.desc: Lily is looking after a big toy baby, but she needs Krash and He-He to babysit her a while

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Squash
programme.desc: When dad and Uncle Stripe play a game of squash, Bluey and Bingo are in control of their every move, and Bingo proves that big siblings don't always beat little siblings.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Hairdressers
programme.desc: During a game of hairdressers, Bluey discovers that big-headed customer Dad has nits! To help treat them Bingo has to find her voice, while Bluey has to find her ears.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Stumpfest
programme.desc: Dad and his mates hit the backyard, ready to rip up some tree stumps! But when Bluey and Bingo take over a stump as a nail salon, Dad finds he's got some negotiating to do.

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Veg-O-Vision Song Contest
programme.desc: Supertato and the Tato Team must battle to save Tato Tower from Evil Pea's earth-shaking stomping performance at the Veg-O-Vision Song Contest.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Carrot Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are admiring Duggee's crop of giant carrots when they hear a noise. They find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor student Lin is engaged to the daughter of a rich man who despises him because of his family's declining status. Lin visits his fiancee before leaving for the Imperial examination, but finds a maid lying dead in blood. As Lin's bloody handprint is left on the site, he is accused of the murder. How can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: Yu Fang Fang survives the massacre of her master's family at the hands of the Crimson Charm gang but loses her arm in the process. Determined, she vows to team up with a swordsman seeking revenge against the ruthless gang.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: A dedicated chief constable nicknamed "The Invincible Fist" is chasing after a band of bandits near a village one day and encounters an innocent blind girl. He quickly falls in love with her, but finds out she is the daughter of a vicious bandit. Will he kill the father of his lover?

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: Shot on the Shaws' lot in the final years of Hong Kong's greatest studio, The Enchantress tells the story of martial artists who disappear in the night! Intrigued, wanna-be detectiveswordsman Feng Chi-wu (Mok Siu-chung) is determined to find out what is happening. But when Feng finds out that an evil vampire spirit (Wei Chiu-hua) is killing swordsmen, he's in for more than he bargains for... It's an outlandish fairy-tale and martial arts fantasy, where your fists and sword aren't nearly enough!

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: Jiang Xiao Yu is separated from his twin brother as a baby after his parents are murdered. He is taken by a couple to Villains Valley and raised to be a villain by a host of outlaws. Jiang leaves the valley to explore the world when he grows up. Will he be able to avenge his parents and meet with his twin brother?

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: A young business man marries a pretty and much sought-after young bride, not knowing that she carries the spirit of a girl raped by her uncle and murdered along with her parents. Justice must be done, and it ain't pretty!

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Young carriage driver Kin offends the gangsters by saving a young girl. His boss immediately fires him to avoid getting into trouble. Since then, Kin is determined to protect the weak and learns the "Tsai Li Fu" style of martial arts from a Shaolin master to challenge the gangsters, finally beating them.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: Notorious assassin Nieh Cheng has retired into hiding. However, when Premier Yen's family is massacred, he seeks out the reclusive swordsman and coaxes him into a final revenge mission in this epic story set in the Six Kingdom era.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the "speed gang", led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the "speed gang" while on the island - can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the "speed gang", led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the "speed gang" while on the island - can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of women's rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: On a routine courier mission, the prestigious Chief was murdered by four mysterious monks. When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. When Lei thought justice was served for the culprits, he soon realizes the table had turned and the monks stroke again. What follows is a series of intense pursuit for the ultimate villain!

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: The Daredevils
programme.desc: Corrupt general Wang Li assumes power by killing his superior. The son of the murdered superior befriends four street performers called "The Venoms", and they help him take revenge by posing as government officials offering a peace token to the corrupt general. When Wang arrives at a warehouse, he is ambushed by the Venoms!

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller; playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives!

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sister's death, but is shocked to discover that her fiance, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jin's mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the 'Embroidery Bandit' starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an inquisitive fighter and detective to capture the culprit.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son's arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Li Xun Huan is a sentimental swordsman who has lived peacefully outside the martial arts world for the past ten years. He returns home after knowing that the Plum Blossom Bandit is back to his old tricks, only to find that everything has changed.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang (Yueh Hua) in a bid to rescue some hostages. She shoots the thug under most peculiar circumstances. Then a series of tragedies occur.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: Only by bringing together the powerful Heaven Sword and the mighty Dragon Sabre can six martial arts sects struggling for supremacy be saved in this thrilling sequel to Chu Yuan's original hit.

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and seriously hurt. Luckily, Master Li saves and treats him, allowing Yun to avoid the ninjas' pursuit.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: Martial arts master Yu has retired for years but is invited to join force with another master Tao to fight against the four famous thieves and retrieve the stolen Dragon Jade. However, Tao's real plan is to possess the treasure himself and kills Yu after he defeats the thieves...

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case...

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: She is in Danger
programme.desc: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote B&B accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yi's ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xue's buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter's company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian military arm dealer to find some munitions and to destroy them. When he finally finds the munitions though, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and has to team up with his partner to recover the munitions so as to prevent a disaster from occurring.

programme.title: Zombie Island
programme.desc: Jeff, a big fan of zombies, goes to a deserted and mysterious island with his friends hoping to seek out exciting adventures. What started as an adventure turns out to be a horrifying journey as they get trapped on the island and are attacked by the zombies! Their lives are in danger when they fail to fight back, and the game has only just begun!

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn...

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team's downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll's eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation...

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man's matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes on a job as a night guard. As the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at the abandoned building, only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: The flagship business program of CGTN’s English language service. The program offers in-depth analysis of the latest economic data, business trends and market moving policies, zooming in on how all this affects ordinary people. With separate editions out of Asia, Europe, Africa and the Americas, Global Business features analysts and news-makers supported through a global network of correspondents. Global Business shows you what's moving markets in both developed and emerging economies.

programme.desc: Africa Live is a news program that focuses on African issues and issues related to this diverse continent. CGTN’s Nairobi-based broadcast center produces Africa Live. Local correspondents and local production teams provide authoritative and in-depth stories from across the region. Africa Live is an objective and comprehensive look at every facet of African life.

The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: World Insight with Tian Wei
programme.desc: World Insight with Tian Wei is a long-running international platform for debate and intelligent discussion. It is the meeting point of both the highly influential and rising voices, facilitated by host, Tian Wei. Every Monday to Friday, it provides nutrition to form your own thoughts and ideas through live debate and interviews. Live debates linking movers and shakers take place in the signature segment "Global Debate".

Inviting decision makers in government, business and academia onto the show, the host encourages guests to speak their minds frankly.

He opens up about the challenges and rewards of his new role, while reflecting on a remarkable career in the Premier League that took him to West Ham United, Newcastle United and Chelsea. From unforgettable moments on the pitch to shaping his approach off it, Ba shares insights into the experiences that continue to influence his vision for the game today.

programme.title: NETBUSTERS - ERLING HAALAND'S 100
programme.desc: We celebrate Erling Haaland's record-breaking haul in true Netbusters' style, showcasing every one of his 100 Premier League goals, squeezed into a special 26-minute show.

programme.title: THE BIG INTERVIEW - EP34
programme.desc: Extended sit-downs and more informal 'out and about' interviews with the Premier League's biggest stars, providing players with a platform to tell their story in their own words.

programme.title: THE BIG INTERVIEW - EP33
programme.desc: With 87 goals to his name Danny Welbeck is the fifth-highest goalscorer among active Premier League players, and across a career spanning 17 seasons he has seen it all. This week, the Brighton striker sits down with former teammate Owen Hargreaves to reflect on his remarkable journey. From his early days at Manchester United and being crowned champion in 2013, to his move to Arsenal where he overcame adversity, and now to his current role thriving as a leader for the Seagulls.

programme.title: Cobra Kai - Cobra Kai Never Dies
